recommended_actions.title: Introduce crypto abstraction boundary for algorithm agility
recommended_actions.rationale: Direct algorithm calls create high migration cost. A boundary layer enables staged classical-to-PQC transitions.
steps: Wrap signing, verification, keygen, and key exchange behind stable interfaces.
Add policy controls to select classical, hybrid, or PQC paths at runtime.
